---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Mayah"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_2015 = rla_score) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_dist |>
      filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
      select(district_id, rla_2023 = rla_score),
    by = "district_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_change)
state_scores <- tbl(con, "state_scores")
state_change <- state_scores |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2015 = rla_score) |>
  inner_join(
    state_scores |>
      filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
      select(stateabb, rla_2023 = rla_score),
    by = "stateabb"
  ) |>
  mutate(score_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2015, rla_2023, score_change)
state_change |>
  collect() |>
  print()
```

```{r}
district_changes <- score_change |>
  collect()

ggplot(district_changes, aes(x = rla_change, fill = rla_change > 0)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "steelblue", `FALSE` = "tomato"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Change in District Reading Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with data in both years:", nrow(district_changes)),
    caption = "Change is the 2023 score minus the 2015 score."
  )
```

```{r}
state_changes <- state_change |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(state_name = fct_reorder(state_name, rla_2023))

ggplot(state_changes, aes(y = state_name)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = rla_2015, xend = rla_2023, yend = state_name, color = score_change > 0),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "inches"))
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = rla_2015), color = "gray") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "steelblue", `FALSE` = "tomato"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Score Changes, 2015–2023",
    subtitle = "States are ordered by their 2023 reading score.",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores; arrows point to 2023 scores."
  )
```
